Hi Dana —

Great to hear; glad the demo was useful. I’ve put together a compact "mutual-plan canvas" and a 1-slide timeline that we can iterate on together. The doc includes:
- Suggested stakeholder RACI (technical, security, procurement, exec)
- Clear acceptance criteria (functional + perf + security)
- Required infra checklist for a VPC-based pilot (KMS, egress rules, audit logging)
- 30/45/60 day milestone lanes and recommended owners

I shared the seed doc and a slide deck here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1AcmExAMPLEacme_map_seed_v1 (edit access for your team) and https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/1AcmExAMPLE_acme_eval_timeline_v1

Key suggestion for your Nov 21 exec sync: surface a single ask (go/no-go decision + budget owner) and the two primary risks (data access + SLA expectations). If that sounds right I’ll prepare a 1-slide "stakeholder ask" you can use.

Attached: acme_map_seed_v1.gdoc (seed) and acme_eval_timeline_v1.gslides (timeline).

Would you like us to lead a short co-edit workshop this week to fill in owners? I can pull Marissa and Ben into drafting the first pass of the pilot acceptance gates.

Thanks,
Chloe

I pushed a clean pass into the shared doc (Acme MAP seed) and attached the timeline slides. Edits I made:
- Acceptance criteria (compact):
  • Functional: end-to-end inference flow (sample app) + accuracy baseline (1000 prompts)
  • Perf: p50 < 120ms for common flows, 99th percentile < 500ms during test window
  • Security: SOC2 controls verified, private VPC connectivity validated, keys in KMS
- Verification steps: owner & day (e.g., "Infra: create test VPC — Ben — day 3")
- Timeline slide: 30/45/60 lanes with procurement check at day 10 and exec decision at day 45
